scene: 試料が並ぶ研究室で、試料管のラックを抱えて20頭分の多さに目を見張る研究者（CHAR-07）。

fences.label: キャラプロンプト（1:1）:
fences.text: (CHAR-07 再利用) Cute cartoon character design, thick black outlines, flat cel-shaded colors, large expressive eyes, children's animation style. A full-body Japanese female researcher in her 40s with shoulder-length dark brown hair tied back, a plain white lab coat over a navy top, grey trousers and black shoes, standing square to the viewer with her shoulder line parallel to the picture plane, her face clearly visible. She holds a white rack of many small capped sample tubes in both hands in front of her chest, eyebrows shot up, eyes stretched wide, mouth open in a small gasp, a bead of sweat on her temple, surprised but determined, NOT calm, NOT smiling. No lettering on the tubes, no badge, no logo, no name tag. Only this one woman, no other people. A very large head about one third of the total height, a short compact torso and short stubby arms and legs, roughly three heads tall. Do NOT draw her with realistic adult proportions — not four, five, six or seven heads tall. Full body. Transparent background, real alpha transparency. 1:1 aspect ratio. Generate 1 image.
